assertions.name: q-system tracks the classical same-nu control at the viscous-scaled horizon (R within [0.2, 5]) at every tested eps — SF1's small-eps sustainment was the viscous timescale, NOT q-specific self-forcing

description: SF2 (epic qou-a3n3): removes SF1's confound by scaling the horizon to the viscous time (T = 1.5/nu k1^2) and running a classical same-nu control (k_n = n) against the q-system (k_n = [n]_q). If the enstrophy survival ratio R = S_q/S_cl stays near 1, the small-eps sustainment seen in SF1 is the viscous timescale and NOT genuine q-core self-forcing; the unforced finite core then decays at every eps on its own clock, and the sustained-forcing blow-up channel requires EXTERNAL or infinite-dimensional sustainment — sharpening the hard core once more. R >> 1 would instead be evidence of q-specific self-sustainment. Scope (a); exploratory tier; float64 RK2.
